_readme: Hand-checked OpenStreetMap places that are never counted in nearby_context. OSM tags them wrongly (a clinic tagged as a hospital, a toll plaza tagged as a mall) or maps one place more than once (a mall and its wings). clean_osm_nearby.py obeys this list on every run.
Key: the place's osm_type/osm_id, copied from data/1_raw/osm_nearby_raw.csv (for example node/1730075068).
kind and name: what the place is in OSM, so the list is easy to read. reason: why it is not counted.
A place that has been corrected in OpenStreetMap itself can be removed from this list; the cleaner reports entries it no longer finds.
